candidate.narrative: Design profile: Strongpoint-Centered Area Defense. Tank task force occupies and prepares obj-slam to retain obj-slam. The defense integrates obstacles and fires in engagement-area to block, contain, and defeat or deny the attacking enemy while retaining the designated terrain. Tank-heavy brigade remains the reserve for reinforcement, blocking, or counterattack under commander commitment criteria. The security force provides early warning and protects the defensive framework. Division fires disrupt and suppress enemy combat power in the engagement area.
